projects.title: Clava
projects.description: Developed for the 2021 Congressional App Challenge, Clava helps connect students within a school district/city to other students with similar interests. My goal in creating this app was to help students from less affluent areas connect with potential mentors and peers. I was able to create an MVP that I demoed for the competition.
